purpose: Define how AIGMos uses Topics as recursive, many-to-many, inheritable and composable grouping/trace surfaces so mechanisms can be specified by reusing existing semantic definitions and declaring only genuinely new causality.

metadata.rule: Composition affects trace reuse only. It does not create execution causality.

topic.minimum_classification: at least one direct or inherited Topic membership, otherwise explicit Outsider

inheritance.effect: grouping context propagates from child Topic to ancestor Topics

composition.effect: reuse existing Topic grouping and trace surfaces

mechanism_specification.principle: Define once -> inherit Topics -> compose Topics -> describe only the new causality.
mechanism_specification.rule: A mechanism specification SHOULD compose existing Topics whenever they already define required semantics. The mechanism adds only missing participants and explicit mechanism-specific flow/causality.
mechanism_specification.gap_rule: If existing Topics plus explicit mechanism-specific causality cannot describe the mechanism, the missing semantic definition is a canonical gap; do not duplicate or invent it.

value.purpose: Group the canonical mechanism by which Topics organize and compose semantic trace surfaces.

invariants.rule: Topic relationships never grant semantic or runtime authority.
Topic composition reuses definitions by reference rather than copying them.
Mechanism-specific causality remains explicit flow data.

hard_gates.condition: Identity has no direct or inherited Topic membership and is not explicitly Outsider.
Topic inheritance cannot be deterministically resolved because of a cycle.
Topic composition cannot be deterministically resolved because of a cycle.
Composed Topic duplicates existing component semantics solely for documentation convenience.
Execution causality is inferred from Topic inheritance or composition.
Ownership, authority, dependency or containment is inferred from Topic inheritance, membership or composition.

references.purpose: Places Topic System under the Core Topic hierarchy.

gaps.description: Legacy Topic field relation_refs is preserved in migration evidence; CCF 2.0 does not justify inventing a Link specialization for it.
Legacy Topic field operation_refs is preserved in migration evidence; CCF 2.0 does not justify inventing a Link specialization for it.
Legacy Topic field flow_refs is preserved in migration evidence; CCF 2.0 does not justify inventing a Link specialization for it.

prose.summary: Defines Topic inheritance, composition, many-to-many membership and Outsider handling as the canonical mechanism for reusable recursive grouping and end-to-end trace views.
notes: The contract is unlocked until the Core Topic root and repository-wide Topic references are validated together.
Pass 8 formalized previously free Flow actor/data/target/condition/payload/result/error tokens as exact owner-scoped member identities while preserving every source literal.

semantics.identity_rule: This member gives an exact owner-scoped identity to the literal Flow token without adding semantics beyond the owning Flow reference field and the preserved source literal.
semantics.interpretation_rule: Consumers may use this identity as an opaque declared Flow symbol. No meaning may be inferred from spelling, whitespace, filename, path or similarity to another symbol.
semantics.authority_rule: A Flow symbol is descriptive/causal model data only and never grants runtime authority, capability, ownership or execution permission.
semantics.scope_rule: Identity is scoped semantically to the defining contract; identical source literals in another contract or another Flow-ref role are not automatically the same semantic identity.
